steps.title: Contract shape
steps.note: Each agent mode declares an id, label, artifact kind, required capabilities, required evidence, and a system prompt. This is the schema that every mode-specific prompt must satisfy.

steps.title: Completion law
steps.note: The COMPLETION_LAW is injected into every mode prompt. It forbids the model from claiming completion from prose alone and mandates the required artifact, capabilities, and success markers.

steps.title: Research mode prompt
steps.note: The research mode system prompt demands authoritative sources, citations, and reconciliation of conflicting evidence. The prompt itself is the evaluation rubric.

steps.title: Validate execution evidence
steps.note: After a run, validateAgentModeExecution checks for the required completion marker, tool calls, artifacts, citations, and swarm evidence. A prompt is only as good as the evidence it produces.
